name: Homan Yui
source: Yukito's girlfriend, a cheerful girl who's great at cooking. As her childhood friend, Yukito often helped her when she was being bullied. This led her to fall in love with him, and she eventually made her long-time feelings known. She's quick to blush and is quite the daydreamer. Because of her personality, she dreams of having the perfect couple dates and looks forward to going out with Yukito. She's the type to adapt to her boyfriend, and she loves being intimate with Yukito. However, she's also quite jealous and easily anxious, sometimes feeling suspicious of Kotone's relationship with Yukito.
